extracted.name: Pisco Sour
extracted.description: Pisco is a style of brandy common to Peru and Chile that has a bit of a tequila flavor. The egg white in gives this tangy pisco sour blender drink a smooth, full body. Don’t forget the bitters, it’s the secret ingredient!
instruction_lines: Place ice cubes, pisco, lemon juice, sugar, egg white, and bitters in a blender. Blend on high speed until finely puréed.
Pour into 2 glasses and garnish with an additional dash of bitter, if desired.
